Profile

Phoropter’s pages are its API. A person and an agent read the same HTML; structure is in rel links and microdata (items have no itemtype; property names are defined here). The top-level item in each page’s <main> is the plan, as-built, place, or home listing the page is about.

Microdata properties

(header)
Every page’s provenance, the item in its <header>: repository and commit (full sha in value).
plan
A plan: title, name and date (from its filename), added (the commit that added it, which orders plans), cart as written, base, file, intro, asBuilt, revisits and revisitedBy links, and its entry items.
asBuilt
An as-built file: title, plan, head, file, and its entry items.
entry
One entry: kind (Decision, Decline, Guess; in an as-built, Changed, Chose, Answered), title, anchor items, reason, source (the parenthesis after Because or Answer, exactly as written), verdict (an answer’s opening word: held, disproved, partly disproved, or not tested; on a guess, inside its answeredBy link’s sentence), answers or answeredBy links, and anchoredBy links from other plans’ entries.
anchor
Where an entry points: where as written, quote if any, new for where (new), note when it is shown but not resolved, place (a symbol or file page) or target (another plan’s entry, or a whole plan), and one view per commit. An anchor at an entry has no views unless it has a quote, and then one, at the generated commit: plans and landed as-builts don’t change.
view
An anchor at one commit: role (base, as-built head, generated), commit, status, file, startLine/endLine for a symbol, matches, note, code, and sameAs when a generated view matches the as-built head’s exactly and its code isn’t repeated. A plan’s anchors have up to three views: base, as-built head (where the plan’s own work landed), and generated.
status
found: the quote matched. not-found: it didn’t. no-quote: nothing to search for. no-file: the file isn’t at that commit. no-symbol: the symbol isn’t in that commit’s index. None of these judges a difference between commits.
place
A symbol or file that plans anchor to: name, kind, symbol or file, a symbol’s whole definition at the generated commit as code, and anchoredBy items.
